persons.name: Amoghasiddhi
persons.evidence: dānapati kāṣṭhamaṇḍapamahānagara, laganatora, gaṅga naṣu vantā<<>>kṛttīpuṇya-mavihārāvasthita, dabhu vantāche ... sākṣabhikṣu śrī-amoghasina, thama svādhyāyāyanimittīna, thva bhagavatipancarakṣāpustaka cocakā juro

persons.name: Dharmakara
persons.evidence: sayao tora darākṣe, ra yitācheyā, vajrācāryya dharmmakarana coyā

relations.evidence: sākṣabhikṣu śrī-amoghasina ... thva bhagavatipancarakṣāpustaka cocakā juro ... vajrācāryya dharmmakarana coyā

purpose: svādhyāyārtha and transfer of merit to parents and all sentient beings (thama svādhyāyāyanimittīna; mātāprītṛpūrvvagamaṃ kṛtvā, sakarasatvarāśeʼnurttarajñānaphalaṃ prāptayatu)
notes: The king's name is placed in parentheses in the transcription, indicating it was supplied or partly legible. The donor's name is given as Amoghasiddhi in the Sanskrit formula ('amoghasirdhi') and in Newari inflected as 'amoghasina' (Amoghasī-na/Amoghasinha).
